title_original: 철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
■ Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion and Support of the Railroad Logistics Industry [Attached Table]

Standards for Imposition of Administrative Fines (Related to Article 10)

1. General Standards
(a) Where reduction is deemed necessary in consideration of the degree, motive, consequences, etc. of the violation, the imposing authority may reduce the administrative fine by up to one-half of the amount under subparagraph 2: Provided, That this shall not apply where the violator is delinquent in paying an administrative fine.
(b) Where any of the following applies, the imposing authority may increase the administrative fine by up to one-half of the amount under subparagraph 2:
1) Where the details and degree of the violation are serious and the damage to consumers, etc. is deemed substantial;
2) Where an increase is otherwise deemed necessary in consideration of the degree, motive, consequences, etc. of the violation.

2. Individual Standards
Violation | Legal Basis | Amount of Administrative Fine
Designation as an international railroad freight transportation business operator by false or other improper means in violation of Article 18 (1) of the Act | Article 21 of the Act | 2 million won
